provenance_selection.note: Compatibility weights are unchanged. A paper is discounted only with positive evidence of repeated evidence. Missing provenance is not counted as independence. The twenty claims remain development evidence. C013, C015, and C016 are held out together.

uncovered_claims.method: Full pooled titles for each of the seven claims, abstracts of the nearest candidates, and one eight-hit Europe PMC query per claim inside the eight-year horizon. Frozen lists were not changed.

claims.verdict: no eligible test found under the specified search and horizon
claims.reason: The nearest paper reports H-Ras vacuolation in glioblastoma, and K-Ras does it too. It is not the primary-melanocyte contrast with BRAF(V600E). The horizon query did not surface a replication of that experiment.

claims.verdict: no eligible test found under the specified search and horizon
claims.reason: The pool contains an extended RAS analysis of a phase III panitumumab versus best-supportive-care trial of the same design as the source. The audit does not count that as a new cohort. Other candidates are wild-type-only series or different regimens, so they do not test the mutant contrast.

claims.verdict: no eligible test found under the specified search and horizon
claims.reason: MYC suppresses BRAF(V600E) senescence in mouse lung. That is a different species and tissue, and it does not compare NRAS(Q61R) in normal human melanocytes. A melanocyte-restricted query did not return another direct test.

claims.verdict: no eligible test found under the specified search and horizon
claims.reason: The nearest paper confirms Apc plus KRAS cooperation on mouse intestinal tumor counts. It does not test whether nuclear beta-catenin accumulation after APC loss requires KRAS in zebrafish or human intestinal cells.

claims.verdict: no eligible test found under the specified search and horizon
claims.reason: Pool papers restore iodide with MAPK inhibitors or measure TGFbeta expression. They do not block TGFbeta/Smad and measure the sodium iodide symporter. PMID 27401113, outside the pool, studies NOX4 as a mediator of symporter loss, which is a different intervention.

claims.verdict: no eligible test found under the specified search and horizon
claims.reason: The pool is combination trials, dosing, and toxicity for cobimetinib. None test whether cobimetinib itself has superior efficacy in BRAF-mutant models. The horizon query returned pharmacokinetics and combination studies.

PMID 36156071 is inside the eight-year horizon and not in the frozen pool. It knocks down Atg5 in KrasG12D;p53 lung tumors: systemic loss reduced established tumor growth and extended survival, while tumor-cell loss did not. The pool's nearest papers delete Atg7 instead.
